title: Sources finishes; the result stays readable
description: Only the completed documentary work folds. The intervening exchange stays in order and the useful result appears last.
prompt: Make one precise UI text correction to this mock. In the leftmost empty Found lane, replace "No documents found yet." with exactly "No documents awaiting capture."
